name: Minimalist HUD
description: Removes unnecessary HUD clutter that can't be disabled via the menu.

options.name: Vanilla (no changes)
options.tooltip: Vanilla UI version

options.name: Minimalist | DEFINITIVE EDITION
options.tooltip: Minimalist HUD - This is the HUD file which contains all the main mod changes for this mod, as well as enabling you to use customized button prompts. See mod page for details on both.

options.name: Throw | Dot Reticle
options.tooltip: Changes the thrown object reticle into a dot

options.name: Throw | Hide Arc
options.tooltip: Hides the 3D throw arc

options.name: Throw | Hide Impact
options.tooltip: Hides the throw aiming landing circle animation

options.name: Remove Exit Icon from HUD
options.tooltip: Remove Exit Icon

options.name: Hide Passport icon (Safehouse)
options.tooltip: Remove Passport icon from the freelancer safehouse

options.name: Hide Freelancer Supplier Icon
options.tooltip: Remove freelancer supplier icon when not using instinct

options.name: Hide Freelancer Crate Icon
options.tooltip: Remove freelancer crate icon. Eventually I'll make figure out how to enable it in instinct but for now, this option removes it completely.

options.name: Hide Freelancer Courier Icon
options.tooltip: Remove freelancer courier icon when not using instinct

options.name: Hide Camera Widget
options.tooltip: Hides the big ugly UI widget in the bottom left of the camera. Goes well with Tumbler's Camera Upgrades scroll to zoom.

options.name: Hide Camera Widget (Suspect Cam)
options.tooltip: Hides the zoom widget in the bottom left of the spy cam. Also dims the main widget. NOTE: also hides the button prompt text for tagging suspects, but the buttons still work.

options.name: Hide Interaction Outline
options.tooltip: Hides the white outline including around NPCs. In-game menu option only affects items.

options.name: Hide Suspect Phone Fx
options.tooltip: Removes the pulsing circle and camera filter from the freelancer suspect burner phones.

options.name: Hide Skeleton
options.tooltip: Hides the cartoonish skeleton showing when people get electrocuted. Like HM2016

options.name: Hide Control Layout on Pause
options.tooltip: Hides the controller layout graphic shown on the pause menu.

options.name: Hide View Intel
options.tooltip: Hides the little View Intel message at the top left of the screen at the start of a mission.

options.name: Minimal Instinct
options.tooltip: No instinct filter, no outlines, more faint NPC highlights

options.name: Shotgun - Dot Crosshair
options.tooltip: The main mod removes the shotgun crosshair entirely, which I think is more fun. But you can enable this option to add a dot crosshair back, if you can't aim ;)

options.name: Fix - stadia icons
options.tooltip: Check this box ONLY IF you're not using Heritage UI AND have hide exit icon unchecked

options.name: Vanilla - No changes
options.tooltip: No changes to prompt text

options.name: Minimalist
options.tooltip: Drag body and open/close door fully hidden (unlock door still shows). Simplified Pick Up and Disguise prompts (only shows weapon name and disguise name), many other common prompts are button-only. You can see what's changed in the manifest.json. The characters prefixing the localisation entries determine what is hidden from the UI.
